description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Reviews and improves existing community_signal_enrichment.py (280 rows in mcp_signal_enrichments). Signal quality shows range 10-80 but may not discriminate adequately. Must read MULTIPLE metadata fields (registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars) to produce differentiated scores. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Verify discrimination against 34 fingerprint inputs per enrichment_harness.py contract.
